Classification audit

Title-keyword labels are provisional. “Reinforcement (design unspecified)” describes a stated purpose, not an inferred construction method. Greenfield versus existing right-of-way cannot be assigned consistently from these records.

How to use the data

  1. Open Project data and filter by project ID or name to inspect dated observations and exact citations.
  2. Use Analysis for screened, project-key-level comparisons. Read each cohort definition before interpreting a percentage.
  3. Open a source web page to find the release, then the exact cited file and locator to verify a value.

An ID may change across source systems; crosswalks are incomplete. “SCE|MULTIPLE WORKORDERS” is split by project name for on-site grouping because it is not a unique project ID.

Cited public-source observations. Missing or conflicting values are not silently filled.
